title.narrative: Improving institutional capacity of Caritas Diocesana Maliana (CDM)

description.narrative:
In January 2010, the Vatican officially erected a third diocese in Timor Leste, the diocese of Maliana. On the request of Monsignor D. Norberto do Amaral, Bishop of the new diocese, in 2011 Catholic Relief Services (CRS) led a needs assessment to inform the programme development for Caritas Diocesana Maliana (CDM), which was established with the new diocese. This needs assessment and resulting report which outlined possible interventions for CDM was supported (financially and technically) by members of Caritas Internationalis in Timor Leste, including CAFOD. The assessment covered needs, actors and gaps in the sectors of health, water and sanitation, peacebuilding and governance, education, livelihoods and emergency preparedness and response.
More recently, since March 2013 CDM has received full time support from a Progressio Development Worker (DW) in the role of an Organisational Development Advisor, funded by Development and Peace (Caritas Canada). The DW has supported CDM to conduct an organisational capacity assessment, which included an analysis and validation of the 2011 community needs assessment, resulting in a one-year capacity building plan based on the needs assessment analysis, strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, constraints and priority organizational areas of CDM.
CAFOD is making a small contribution to support the initial stages of this plan, including the recruitment of staff and a strategic planning workshop, as part of the final stage of CAFOD’s programme in Timor Leste. The long term aim (beyond CAFOD’s withdrawal) is the development of CDM as a model diocesan Caritas in accountability, transparency and programme management (pastoral and community development).
